skill.name: yelp
skill.description: Search local businesses and retrieve Yelp business details and reviews through fetcher.sh using prepaid credits or USDC payments.
skill.summary: Access paid local business search, details, and reviews through HTTP or a remote MCP service.
skill.author: fetcher-sh

security_audit.summary: All 57 static findings are false positives involving Markdown, reference links, documented API calls, placeholders, or expected service authentication. No evidence found of malware, credential theft, or prompt injection in the reviewed file. A separate payment-safety finding concerns automatic signing without documented spending limits and nonrefundable upstream failures.

remediation.issue: Automatic payments and paid MCP tools lack documented spending safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Require payment consent, enforce per-call and session budgets, cap paid retries, and confirm credit topups before execution.

remediation.issue: Upstream failures can consume funds without refunds.
remediation.suggestion: Explain nonrefundable settlement before payment and stop automatic retries after paid failures unless the user approves additional spending.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic payments lack documented spending safeguards
semantic_findings.description: The guide says payment signing and retries are automatic and exposes paid MCP tools without spending limits or confirmation requirements. Nonrefundable upstream failures can amplify losses from repeated agent calls.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Automatic signing, paid tools, and nonrefundable settlement are explicit; this file supplies no consent or budget controls. External implementations may impose safeguards, but were not reviewed.

content.value_statement: Local business research requires searching listings and gathering details and reviews. This skill documents paid fetcher.sh requests for these tasks through HTTP and MCP.
actual_capabilities: Search businesses using a query and location.
Sort search results by recommendation, rating, or review count.
Retrieve business details using an ID or Yelp URL handle.
Retrieve business reviews with page-based pagination.
Document prepaid Bearer authentication and the x402 payment flow.
Provide remote MCP configuration and identify free and paid tools.
limitations: Requires access to the third-party fetcher.sh service and prepaid credits or a compatible USDC payment setup.
Lists a price of $0.003 per endpoint call; pricing and availability require verification with the provider.
The provider states upstream failures are nonrefundable; this guide supplies no spending controls.
Contains instructions only; it does not implement the service, guarantee data freshness, or include the linked payment guide.

best_practices: Verify current pricing and authorize a request budget before paid calls or credit topups.
Keep service keys outside prompts and shared configuration; send them only to the intended provider.
Use explicit locations, supported sort values, and limited pagination; stop after paid failures.
anti_patterns: Allowing automatic paid retries or credit topups without spending approval.
Placing live Bearer keys in shared files, chat messages, or logs.
Treating returned reviews as complete, current, or statistically representative without verification.

faq.question: Is this the official Yelp Fusion API?
faq.answer: No. It documents a third-party fetcher.sh service for Yelp business data, not a direct Yelp Fusion integration.

faq.question: How are requests paid?
faq.answer: The guide supports prepaid credits with a Bearer key or per-call USDC payments through x402.

faq.question: What does a request cost?
faq.answer: The guide lists $0.003 per call for its four data endpoints. Verify current prices before approving requests.

faq.question: Can I sort and paginate results?
faq.answer: Search supports recommendation, rating, and review-count sorting plus pagination. Review retrieval also supports a page parameter.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill provides HTTP instructions and remote MCP configuration. Execution depends on the client's tools, connectivity, credentials, and payment setup.

faq.question: Are failed requests refunded?
faq.answer: The guide states that upstream failures are nonrefundable because settlement precedes delivery. Approve budgets and avoid uncontrolled retries.
